_comment: Spelling variants the automatic fold cannot catch (they differ by letters, not
by case/space/punctuation). Keys are place_key() values of the folded name, so
they are lower-case alphanumerics only. Values are the name to publish.
Only add a pair here when it is the SAME place — 'Kalwad' and 'Kalwar' are two
different villages in Jaipur district and must stay apart.
